results.title: Joybubbles
results.overview: Joybubbles discovers he can manipulate the telephone system by whistling a magic tone. Born blind and yearning for connection, his early obsession unwittingly lays the groundwork for a subculture that shapes the future of hacking and technology.

results.title: Barry & Me
results.overview: Late 18th century: In the midst of the picturesque but unforgiving Swiss mountains, 12-year-old Georg finds himself stranded with the monks on the Great St. Bernard Pass. His new life consists of cold, loneliness, and work—until he rescues a puppy from starvation.

results.title: Now What?
results.overview: An intimate portrait of a relationship suspended in time - a breath held before the plunge. Alice and Paul have exhausted words; the silence between them resonates with everything unspoken. They stand at the edge of something irreversible, knowing change must come, yet unsure if they're brave enough to face it.

results.title: BTS WORLD TOUR [ARIRANG] in Buenos Aires
results.original_title: BTS WORLD TOUR [ARIRANG] in Buenos Aires
results.overview: This cinema presentation brings BTS’s Buenos Aires concert to the big screen, marking the group’s first performance in Argentina and its first live viewing broadcast from South America. Audiences can experience the explosive atmosphere of a packed stadium in a 195-minute event, with some territories receiving a time-shifted screening.

results.title: La Bohème
results.overview: In present day East End, an aspiring novelist falls in love with a Ukrainian cleaner whilst his best friend attempts to rekindle his romance with a social climbing sex bomb.

results.title: Bushe
results.overview: Marta, a lovesick 15 year old, pines for a local boy named Karlo. As the traditional local carnival approaches, its mystical atmosphere and mask making tradition will take her on a personal journey where she will discover the true meaning of her identity.

results.title: The 4 Lives of Pyotr Mamonov
results.overview: How did four contradictory personas coexist within a single individual—rowdy drifter, rock star, great actor, and Orthodox hermit? Pavel Lungin’s new film chronicles the life journey of Pyotr Mamonov, exploring his search for meaning and the spiritual transformation of this cult musician and actor. The film weaves together unique archival footage, interviews spanning years, previously unseen home videos, and recollections from those close to him—including Sergey Shnurov, Evgeny Margulis, Viktor Sukhorukov, his wife Olga Mamonova, Viktoriya Isakova, Sergey Loban, and many others.

results.title: Kaakaa
results.overview: A rough person from madurai, an educated person from thiruchchi, and a curiosity disorder person from chennai and there was a situation where these three persons had to fall in love with two elder sisters and one younger sister. and there was competition and challenges arise but the rest of the story was about whom the sisters will fall in love and get married. this is a full-length comedy film and love story named kaaka.

results.title: Eu Não Te Ouço
results.overview: Two Brazilians meet by chance and embark on a peculiar journey.

results.title: Requiem for the Caspian
results.overview: As the Caspian Sea disappears, its spirit haunts the fishermen and women, and other resident creatures, in a desperate attempt to remember their forgotten stories, while an uncertain future beckons.

results.title: Angikaaram
results.overview: Inspired by true events, this film follows the journey of a man who has had enough, fights for recognition against a system shaped strictly by politics and power.

results.title: Until You're Alone
results.overview: After becoming the lead suspect in a series of brutal slayings, a close-minded architect must team up with a free-spirited sex worker in order to clear his name and solve the crimes before they become the killer's next victims in this suspenseful, stylish, and hilarious queer love letter to Hitchcock, De Palma, and the Italian giallo.

results.title: Tiger's Rampage
results.overview: A bachelorette party in the woods becomes a fight for survival when a Bengal tiger escapes the zoo during a storm. Trapped without phone service or escape routes, the women must outwit the predator stalking their cabin.

results.title: Ephemera
results.overview: In post-pandemic Shanghai, two women — one leaving, one staying — share a single electric night wandering the city. A tender, breezy queer love story where chemistry, connection and bittersweet goodbyes feel thrillingly alive.

results.title: Entre mates y conjuros
results.overview: Dori, a retired woman addicted to the lottery, resorts to necromancy to try to make money after the death of her neighbor, unleashing terrifying consequences.

results.title: How to Feed a Dictator
results.overview: Five private chefs to fearsome dictators all over the world share their experiences of the kitchens and circumstances that led them to these sometimes dangerous and often morally compromising workplaces.

results.title: Angel Flight THE MOVIE
results.original_title: エンジェルフライト THE MOVIE
results.overview: The hit series about final goodbyes between the dead and the living across borders comes to the big screen. Angel Hearse receives a wave of international repatriation requests: a couple in Mexico in a movie-like romance, a baby, a man in a wheelchair on a world journey, an American star and his secret love, and Nami, who heads to Mexico after news her lover is alive. Will miracle reunions await?

results.title: Brace for the Storm
results.overview: While families gather on Mid-Autumn Eve, veteran employee Fang refuses to go home, leaving her stranded with a homesick Hong Kong student worker. When a typhoon strikes, this clashing pair must join forces through the tempestuous night to save their crumbling sanctuary.
